mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past 6 months signals rising inflation expectations, leading to higher interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI growth does not correlate with interest rate changes (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% decrease in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% increase in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the past 6 months signals rising economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not correlate with economic activity (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% increase in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is amplified when the unemployment rate is below 5%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening monetary cycle periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 5% increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals rising housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is amplified when the Consumer Price Index (CPI) is below 2%.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST growth does not correlate with housing demand (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A 1% decrease in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to higher wages and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This effect is amplified when the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is above 100.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2% decrease in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over the past 6 months signals declining economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is amplified when the federal funds rate is above 4%.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with economic activity (Pearson r < 0.3).
